steps.text: Wagons provide extra inventory space for your journey. They are easier to pull on roads and sidewalks. Wagons can also be equipped with electric motors and batteries for easier movement.
Craft a campfire to cook food and boil dirty water.
Use a knife on clothing to create rags. Rags can be used in crafting and as fuel for fires.
Use an empty water bottle on a water puddle to collect dirty water
You should find some clothes to put on before going outside. Right-click on doors to open them. If you run out of ACTION POINTS, end your turn.
Click on clothes, then click on your clothing slots to equip.
Click on the crowbar, then click on your melee slot to equip it. Use the action button above the map to attack nearby enemies.
Place a hammer on the ground, then right-click the bed to disassemble.
Right click the shovel to dig. Click on the ground (where items appear) to dig a hole. Select the seeds then click on the hold to plant. If you run out of ACTIION POINTS, end your turn.
Use the rubber hose on the fuel cover to put fuel into your fuel can. Fuel can be used in generators which can power battery chargers.
Special containers such as lunchboxes help you organize specific item types, increasing inventory space. Right-click to open the container.
To load ammo into a gun or magazine, click the ammo, then click the gun/mag.
